recipe.visualDefinition: A high-glamour 1970s aesthetic featuring a central female figure in a provocative pose amidst luxury items, set against a backdrop of dark, heavy velvet curtains with a soft-focus, grainy film texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned centrally, leaning forward to create depth
High-contrast highlights on metallic surfaces against dark velvet
Typography integrated into the top third, framing the subject's head
Warm skin tones contrasting with deep brown and black surroundings
coreInvariants: Heavy vertical drapery in the background
Reflective circular table surface in the foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a woman leaning over a table, occupying the center and lower-right quadrants.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright metallic ice bucket on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large display text at the top, down to the subject's face, following her arm to the champagne glasses on the table.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured areas in the upper corners and lower-left foreground.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep chocolate brown and black (background and clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale cream and gold (typography and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between skin/metal and the dark environment.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast (thick verticals, hairline horizontals)
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' has a very high crossbar
The 'R' has a tight, elegant leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a large, high-contrast serif and a small, slanted geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rules flanking the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and high contrast of the display text.
Provides the necessary modern serif structure with condensed proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1970s style photograph of a woman with curly hair in a black cocktail outfit, leaning over a dark reflective table with champagne glasses and a silver ice bucket. The background consists of dark brown pleated velvet curtains. Use soft lighting, a slight hazy glow, and visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large, extra-condensed modern serif text in cream at the top. Below it, add a smaller italicized sans-serif subtitle in gold, centered and flanked by two thin horizontal lines.

verificationChecks: Is the display text extremely tall and narrow?
Does the image have a soft, analog film quality?
Are the curtains vertically textured and dark?
Is the lighting focused on the subject's face and the metallic objects?

adjustableVariables: Curtain color (deep red, navy, or brown)
Specific luxury props on the table
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the model
Any brand logos on the champagne bottle
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Background must show vertical curtain folds
Reflections must be visible on the table surface
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [1970s analog photography] + [Dark velvet backdrop] + [Extra-condensed high-contrast serif typography] + [Soft-focus highlights].
